gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: headache as chief complaint. Gen cc-001: blinding headache for three days. Headache is captured; added descriptor and duration but not contradictory.
Gold: 3-day history of headache. Gen hpi-001: headache started three days ago. Duration is captured; additional descriptors are extra but consistent.
Gold: starts on waking up. Gen hpi-001 and hpi-008 both indicate onset upon waking and presence on awakening. This is captured.
Gold: over the right eye. Gen hpi-003: stronger over the right eye. This includes and is consistent with the gold location.
Gold: seeing lights in front of the eyes. Gen hpi-005: visual disturbances described as shooting lights or 'weird' vision. This covers lights in front of eyes with extra description.

Gold: worse when stands up but not when bends over/cough/sneeze. Gen hpi-009: standing up quickly produces stabbing pain and sensation of something moving. Worsening with standing is captured; lack of worsening with bending/cough/sneeze is omitted but not contradicted.
Gold: severity 5–8/10. Gen hpi-002: typically 8/10, sometimes 5/10. Same range; covered.
Gold: ibuprofen eases slightly but not resolving. Gen hpi-004: provides only slight relief and does not completely resolve. Fully captured.
Gold: well before this episode. Gen pmh-001: no significant medical problems other than remote headaches. This reflects being well before; minor elaboration but consistent.
Gold: has been lacking in energy but no weight loss. Gen ros-010 mentions no weight changes but does not state lack of energy/fatigue. The positive symptom (lacking energy) is missing.

Gold: previous generalized mild headaches with altered vision. Gen pmh-001 adds prior occasional headaches but explicitly says resolved without identified cause and does not reference associated altered vision. The association with altered vision is omitted.
Gold: worse in the light (photophobia). Gen hpi-005 and ros-001/ros-002 explicitly note photophobia. Covered.

Gold: vision not disturbed during the current episode. Gen facts emphasize intermittent visual disturbances (hpi-005, ros-002) and do not state that vision is not disturbed; this is the opposite emphasis, so the gold fact is not captured.
Gold: PMH nil. Gen pmh-001: no significant medical problems. This matches overall PMH, though adds history of youth headaches.

Gold: currently taking Mercilon (OCP). Gen med-001: taking oral contraceptive pill started about one year ago. Same medication class and current use; specific brand is omitted but the fact is covered.
Gold: self-treating with ibuprofen for headache. Gen med-002 and hpi-004: occasional ibuprofen for headache with slight relief. Covered.
Gold: mum has migraine. Gen fh-001: mother has history of migraines with vomiting. Adds vomiting but confirms migraine; covered.
Gold: non-smoker. Gen sh-002: does not smoke. Same fact.
Gold: no illicit drugs. Gen sh-004: no recreational drugs. Equivalent wording; covered.
Gold: 3 beers/week. Gen sh-003: drinks alcohol about once per week, approximately three units. This matches the amount and general frequency; covered.
Gold: works from home. Gen sh-005: works from home and has missed work due to headache. Work-from-home status is captured.
Gold: impression likely migraine. Gen asm-001: possible migraine; migraine appears likely. This contains and elaborates on the same impression.
Gold: needs neurological examination to exclude other pathology. Gen plan-001: schedule detailed neurological examination incl. fundoscopy to assess and exclude secondary causes. Covered.

Gold: advised regular paracetamol. Gen mentions stronger analgesic and paracetamol with food in plan-002 but does not clearly state advising regular paracetamol specifically as in the gold text. The explicit instruction for regular paracetamol is not clearly reproduced.

Gold: prescribed anti-inflammatory to take with food. Gen plan-002 and plan-008: stronger analgesic than ibuprofen and paracetamol to be taken with food; prescribed medications with food. Anti-inflammatory with food requirement is covered in intent, though wording is broader.

Gold: contact us straightaway or go to A&E if severe/unrelenting. Gen plan-004 and fu-003: seek emergency care if headache worsens rapidly/becomes unbearable, or if condition deteriorates; consistent with gold escalation instructions.
Gold: no nausea/vomiting. Gen hpi-006, ros-004, ros-005: no nausea or vomiting. Covered.
Gold: no altered taste/smell. Gen hpi-007: no changes in smell or taste. Covered.
Gold: no rash. No generated fact mentions rash. Omitted.
Gold: no fever. Gen ros-007: negative for fever. Covered.

Gold: no coryzal symptoms. Gen ros-008/ros-009 and hpi-010 list absence of sore throat, cough, cold symptoms, sinus pain, etc. This substantially covers lack of coryzal symptoms, although the exact term is not used.
Gold: not woken up in the night. Gen hpi-008: does not wake the patient at night. Covered.
Gold: no tingling/numbness/weakness. Gen hpi-007: no tingling, numbness, weakness; ros-006: no neurological deficits. Covered.
Gold: vision not disturbed. Gen hpi-005 and ros-002 explicitly state visual disturbances. This directly conflicts with the gold documentation.
Gold: BP last checked 1 year ago was normal. Gen pe-001 notes vitals not documented and plan-005 states BP to be checked next appointment; prior normal BP one year ago is not mentioned. Omitted.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Headache and 3-day duration are supported (cc-001, hpi-001). The descriptor 'blinding' is an added severity detail not in gold but not contradicted.
Onset three days ago on waking and severity are supported (hpi-001, hpi-002, hpi-006). 'Sudden' onset and 'blinding' severity are additions; not contradicted by gold.
Severity range 5–8/10 matches gold severity 5–8/10.
Stronger over right eye is supported by 'over right eye'. Description of 'all over the head' is additional and not addressed in gold.
Ibuprofen gives slight relief and does not resolve headache, matching gold.

Gold states 'vision not disturbed' (hpi-012, ros-008). This fact introduces intermittent visual disturbances. While photophobia is supported (hpi-011), the visual disturbance component directly contradicts gold.
States no nausea or vomiting, matching gold ROS (ros-001).
No tingling, numbness, weakness (ros-007) and no changes in smell or taste (ros-002) are fully supported.
Present upon awakening (hpi-002) and not waking at night (ros-006) are supported. The claim that it is 'present constantly' is additional; constancy is not documented in gold.
Worsening when standing is supported. Description of stabbing quality and sensation of something moving inside head is additional detail not found in gold but not contradicted.
Denial of recent cold symptoms and sore throat/cough is consistent with 'no coryzal symptoms' (ros-005). Denials of ear pain, sinus pain, phlegm, nosebleeds, hemoptysis are additions not in gold.
Photophobia is present and consistent with 'worse in the light'.
States ROS positive for visual disturbances, which conflicts with gold statements that vision is not disturbed (hpi-012, ros-008).
Stabbing pain with positional change (standing) aligns with gold noting worsening when standing. The term 'stabbing' is added detail.
Negative for nausea aligns with 'no nausea/vomiting'.
Negative for vomiting aligns with 'no nausea/vomiting'.
No neurological deficits is consistent with no tingling, numbness, or weakness.
Negative for fever matches 'no fever'.
Negative for sore throat is consistent with lack of coryzal symptoms; sore throat itself not explicitly in gold but fits absence of URTI symptoms.
Negative for cough is consistent with no coryzal symptoms; cough not explicitly named in gold.
Gold states no weight loss; this fact states no weight changes. Broader but directionally consistent; slight generalization beyond documented weight loss.

No significant medical problems aligns with PMH: Nil. Occasional youth headaches are additional; gold does mention previous mild generalized headaches with altered vision but current gen text omits the altered vision association and adds that cause was never identified.
Current OCP use is supported by Mercilon in gold; start time and lack of side effects are additional.
Occasional ibuprofen for headache is consistent with gold use of ibuprofen.
Gold facts do not mention allergies at all. This introduces a new domain (allergies) without conflict.
Mother has migraines is supported; vomiting component is additional detail.
Patient lives alone is not addressed in gold social history; added information.
Does not smoke = non-smoker.
Three units weekly approximates 3 beers/week; same magnitude.
No recreational drugs aligns with no illicit drugs.
Works from home is supported; 'missed work due to headache' is additional context not in gold.
Gold only notes a past BP check one year ago; it does not comment on current vitals documentation. Statement that vitals are not documented is new and not inferable from gold.
Plan for neurological exam is supported by gold plan for neurological exam. Eye examination component and explicit statement that physical exam is not documented are additions.

States recent eye check was normal with no change in vision, but gold explicitly documents 'vision not disturbed' and denies visual disturbances; there is no gold support for a separate formal eye check. This is new clinical data; given gold does not mention any prior eye evaluation, it is best classified as ADDITION rather than contradiction.

Possible/likely migraine is supported. However, this assessment assumes photophobia and visual disturbances; visual disturbances conflict with gold (vision not disturbed). The migraine impression and need to exclude secondary causes are supported; the inclusion of visual disturbances component is contradictory to gold.
Assessment regarding relationship of OCP to headache and planned risk evaluation is not present in gold facts.
Scheduling detailed neurological exam including fundoscopy is consistent with gold plan for neurological exam to exclude other pathology.

Gold: advise regular paracetamol and prescribe anti-inflammatory with food. Gen: stronger analgesic than ibuprofen and paracetamol with food. Use of stronger analgesic/anti-inflammatory with food is supported (plan-003), but explicit positioning 'stronger than ibuprofen and paracetamol' and combined regimen is added. It also does not clearly preserve the 'regular paracetamol' instruction.
Advising to monitor headache severity and pattern is not specified in gold; follow-up and escalation are, but not structured monitoring details.
Seek emergency care if headache worsens rapidly/becomes unbearable or neurologic symptoms develop aligns with gold instruction to contact clinic or A&E if severe/unrelenting.
Plan to check BP at next appointment to assess pill suitability is not mentioned in gold, which only notes prior normal BP one year ago.
Counsel regarding contraindications of OCP in migraine with aura is new content; gold only notes likely migraine without discussing contraceptive counseling.
Continuing current pill until reassessment is not present in gold plan.
Taking prescribed medications with food matches gold direction to take anti-inflammatory with food, though generalized to all prescribed meds.
Monitoring symptoms and returning if worsening or new symptoms appear is consistent with gold advice to contact clinic/A&E if headache worsens/severe, but adds the notion of new symptoms broadly.
Advice to maintain hydration and rest is not mentioned anywhere in gold.
Attending a booked appointment for full assessment is not explicitly in gold facts (gold only notes need for neurological exam).
Permission to cancel the appointment if symptoms resolve is not in gold.
Advising to contact clinic or ED if condition deteriorates before appointment is consistent with gold instruction to contact clinic or A&E if headache gets worse or becomes severe/unrelenting.
